Description
2013 1 oz Canadian Silver Wildlife Series Wood Bison Coin .9999 Fine Silver
The sixth and final coin in the Royal Canadian Mint’s acclaimed Wildlife Series. The 2013 Wood Bison contains 1 oz of .9999 fine silver with a mintage limited to just 1,000,000 coins — a beloved collectible and sound silver investment.
Add the **2013 1 oz Canadian Silver Wildlife Series Wood Bison Coin** to your collection — the sixth and final release in the Royal Canadian Mint’s celebrated Canadian Wildlife Series. Struck in 1 Troy ounce of .9999 fine silver, this coin represents the pinnacle of the series and is one of the most sought-after issues among both silver bullion investors and wildlife coin collectors.
Introduced in 2011, the Canadian Wildlife Series was designed to showcase Canada’s most iconic and ecologically significant wild animals. Beginning with the Wolf, the series produced a new coin every six months over three years, each dedicated to a different creature from Canada’s vast wilderness. The Wood Bison was chosen as the fitting finale — a species officially listed under Canada’s Species at Risk Act, making this coin not only a beautiful piece of silver art but also a tribute to conservation.
With a mintage limited to just 1,000,000 coins globally, the 2013 Wood Bison remains one of the most popular pieces from the entire Wildlife Series. Its combination of exceptional .9999 purity, iconic Royal Canadian Mint craftsmanship, legal tender status in Canada, and its significance as the series closer make it a standout piece in any precious metals portfolio.
Design of
2013 1 oz Canadian Silver Wildlife Series Wood Bison Coin .9999 Fine Silver
The **reverse** was designed by acclaimed Canadian artist **Emily S. Damstra**, who contributed to numerous Royal Canadian Mint coin series. It depicts a powerful Wood Bison wading through deep snow in Canada’s boreal wilderness, with majestic fir trees forming the backdrop. The intricate detailing — from the thick, textured fur of the bison to the weight of fresh snowfall — captures the raw resilience of this majestic animal in its natural habitat. Inscriptions of weight and purity appear in both English and French, with “CANADA” arched above the animal.
The **obverse** features the distinguished right-facing portrait of Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II, as rendered by Canadian portrait artist **Susanna Blunt** in 2003. The year of issue “2013” and the face value of “5 DOLLARS” are engraved alongside the portrait.
